type X = { [K in "a" | "b" as "x"]: K };
const a: X = { x: "a" };
const b: X = { x: "b" };
type U = { [K in "a" | "A" as Uppercase<K>]: K };
const u: U = { A: "a" };
type A = { x?: number; readonly y: string };
type B = { [K in keyof A as `pre_${K}`]: A[K] };
const bb: B = { pre_y: "s" };
type C = { [K in keyof A]: A[K] };
const cc: C = { y: "s" };
console.log(a, b, u, bb);
